## History

Stroud originally started out as a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist). During a spring visit to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh with Captain Saul and Miss Winifred, he became a topic of lively conversation and banter regarding theology, local gossip, and neighbors.
